actions.NONE: no recovery action; state is already consistent
actions.RETRY: pending intent with broker flat -> safe idempotent resubmit
actions.RECONSTRUCT: reconstruct local owned truth from broker (no resubmit) OR mark close-pending as closed
actions.CLOSE_RETRY: close-pending position still at broker -> retry close
actions.BLOCK: divergence cannot be resolved automatically; block new risk

ownership_rule.runtime_owned: broker position ownership_tag matches a durable intent/owned-position tag OR broker magic equals the runtime magic
ownership_rule.foreign: any other position; reported and NEVER modified, never blocks the runtime on its own
